name: Spinach & Ricotta Stuffed Zucchini Boats with Blistered Tomato Toasts

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean-up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
4 medium zucchini squash
2 pints grape tomatoes
1 (5 oz) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise. Scrape out the soft flesh from the middle of each half, place in a medium bowl, and set aside for later use.
Arrange zucchini halves, cut-side up, on one half of the baking sheet pan; drizzle with oil and season with spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add grape tomatoes to the other half of the baking sheet. Drizzle with oil, then season with spices; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer. Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until zucchini are starting to soften, 5-7 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop reserved zucchini flesh and return to the bowl.
Roughly chop spinach. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl.

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and garlic to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are softened, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
When the veggies are done, add ricotta, half of the Parmesan, salt, and pepper to the pan. Stir to combine the filling. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (15 oz) pkg ricotta cheese
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the zucchini boats have started to soften, divide filling between them, then top with reserved Parmesan. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to bake until zucchini is tender, cheese is bubbly, and tomatoes have started to burst, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the zucchini boats are done, change oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Arrange bread on a baking sheet. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes. Remove from oven and cut toast in half. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
To serve, divide zucchini boats and toast between plates. Top toast with blistered tomatoes and enjoy!
